description:
### Description

Create the Wheel Loader Safety Plan (`HWL_00SP_01.001`) from the QF-17 template. For each safety deliverable across safety lifecycle phases 1–10, fill in the six robot-team columns: Work Product Release, Author, Verification Independence Reviewer, Gate Reviewer, Deadline, and Status. Deadlines must align with the WL program and PDP timelines. This supports the PDP Phase 3 Closeout (HWL-1915) by establishing what safety evidence exists, what's ongoing, and what's blocked.

Source: [QF-17 Safety Plan](https://autonomoussolutions.sharepoint.com/:w:/r/sites/productppps/Shared%20Documents/Company%20QMS%20Policies%20%26%20Standards/QF-17%20Safety%20Plan.docx?d=wa3d9fb0f96894245bbcf334aa6c264ae&csf=1&web=1&e=a2eLsS)

### Definition of Done

* \[ \] `HWL_00SP_01.001` created from QF-17 and stored in DMS
* \[ \] All six robot-team columns filled for every deliverable in phases 1–10, with Out-of-Scope or Alternative statuses justified
* \[ \] Deadlines aligned to WL program and PDP timelines
* \[ \] Reviewed by the Functional Safety Tech Lead
* \[ \] Linked as Phase 3 exit evidence under HWL-1915

### Description

Produce the Wheel Loader Activity Flow, using the Platform Activity Flow in PLAT_00SD_01.000 §6 as the baseline. Record WL-specific gaps and additions in the WL Scope Definition (QF-12), as the platform document requires for program teams. This is a QF-17 Phase 1 (Concept Development) deliverable.

Sources: [PLAT_00SD_01.001 Platform Product](https://autonomoussolutions.sharepoint.com/:b:/r/sites/ConstructionLeadership/Shared%20Documents/ASI%20-%20Haulage/0100%20Earth%20Loading/00%20General/!Architecture/PLAT_00SD_01.000%20Platform%20Product/PLAT_00SD_01.001%20Platform%20Product.pdf?d=w073609f17e94425b8593c2fce75633b0&csf=1&web=1&e=XmlLFo), [QF-17 Safety Plan](https://autonomoussolutions.sharepoint.com/:w:/r/sites/productppps/Shared%20Documents/Company%20QMS%20Policies%20%26%20Standards/QF-17%20Safety%20Plan.docx?d=wa3d9fb0f96894245bbcf334aa6c264ae&csf=1&web=1&e=a2eLsS)

### Definition of Done

* \[ \] Platform Activity Flow (§6) reviewed against WL operation, including UC-01 Loading Aggregate and WL work-implement functions
* \[ \] WL Activity Flow created, with gaps and additions from the platform baseline identified
* \[ \] Activity Flow included in the WL Scope Definition (`HWL_00SD_01.000`, QF-12) and stored in DMS
* \[ \] Reviewed through Scope Definition review; gate reviewed by the Functional Safety Tech Lead and Systems Tech Lead
* \[ \] Status updated on the WL Safety Plan

### Description

STPA Step 4 — identify loss scenarios for the WL Unsafe Control Actions from Step 3 (HWL-2574). Worked jointly with Javier/Tim.

### Definition of Done

- [ ] Step 3 UCAs complete
- [ ] Loss scenarios identified for each UCA
- [ ] Scenarios traced to UCAs and hazards
- [ ] Ready for peer review
